subunit: Heterotrimeric G proteins are composed of 3 units; alpha, beta and gamma. The alpha chain contains the guanine nucleotide binding site. Component of the TAS2R14-GNAS2 complex, consisting of TAS2R14, GNAS2, GNB1 and GNG2; within the complex interacts with TAS2R14; this complex plays a role in the perception of bitterness. Interacts with CRY1; the interaction may block GPCR-mediated regulation of cAMP concentrations. Interacts with ADCY5 and stimulates its adenylyl cyclase activity. Interacts with ADCY6 and stimulates its adenylyl cyclase activity. Interacts with ADCY2. Interacts (GDP-bound form) with RIC8B; promoting GNAS folding and association with the plasma membrane. Interaction with SASH1. Interacts with GAS2L2. Interacts with HRH2. Interacts with GPR12, GNB1 and GNG2. Interacts with GPR3. Interacts with GPR6. Interacts with GCGR
